name: todo-01
title: Todo 01 - A Task List With An Aggregate Bar
description: A task list with a checkbox, a title, an optional note, an owner, a due reading and a state per task, plus an aggregate progress bar. The checkbox is the published control rather than a clickable div, so it owns its focus ring and its hit target and a keyboard reader can reach every task. A finished task stays in the list, struck through and muted, because a completed task a reader cannot find is a task they will redo. The bar takes the caller's words as a string rather than a callback, because a function cannot cross from a server Component into a client one. Every string is passed in as a prop.
